corrected_body:
from glom import glom,Switch,Val,Match
spec=Switch([(Match(int),lambda x:x+1),(Match(str),str.upper)],default=Val('other'));values=[glom(x,spec) for x in (2,'word',None)];print('case_dispatch',values);assert values==[3,'WORD','other']
reason: Bare int/str are callable conversion specs in glom; use actual Match(int)/Match(str) to request type matching. Original source/runs/requirements unchanged; run002 needed.
